Summary: Checkout button unresponsive when cart total exceeds $500
Description:
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Add items totaling over $500 to the cart.
2. Navigate to /checkout.
3. Click 'Proceed to Checkout'.

Expected Result: User redirected to payment gateway.
Actual Result: Button becomes disabled, console throws TypeError: orderLimitExceeded.

Summary: SQL Error 500 thrown on product search with single quote
Description:
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open search bar on homepage.
2. Enter the input: Men's Watch.
3. Press Enter.

Expected Result: Return matching products or empty results.
Actual Result: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error displayed.

Summary: User profile image upload fails for standard JPEG format
Description:
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Go to Profile Settings.
2. Click 'Upload Profile Picture'.
3. Select valid 2MB image.jpeg.

Expected Result: Image uploaded and avatar updated.
Actual Result: UI shows 'Invalid file format' error toast.

Summary: Discount coupon SAVE20 applies twice on page refresh
Description:
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Apply coupon code SAVE20 in cart.
2. Refresh browser window using F5.

Expected Result: Discount remains 20%.
Actual Result: Discount stacks to 40% on total order amount.

Summary: Typo in Password Reset email template
Description:
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Request password reset on login page.
2. Open received confirmation email.

Expected Result: 'Click here to reset your password'.
Actual Result: Reads 'Click hear to reset your password'.
